overview: Recurring operational control, incident response, trend reporting, changes and service improvement through an agreed rota. The scope is built around service SLOs, monitoring events and change procedures, producing runbooks, response rota, monthly reliability evidence and escalation. A customer-named service owner approves the work. The service-specific assurance focus is incident simulations and failover handoffs.

scope:
1) Kickoff: sponsor and access agreement.
2) Baseline: capture current state and critical controls.
3) Delivery: Recurring operational control, incident response, trend reporting, changes and service improvement through an agreed rota.
4) Acceptance: contract-specific monthly operating report and issue register; verify incident simulations and failover handoffs.
5) Handover: runbooks, unresolved items, knowledge transfer and acceptance sign-off.
Schedule, coverage and technical staffing: to be confirmed per market and SOW; no guaranteed 24x7 unless contracted.
